The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Pack my box with five dozen liquor
jugs. How vexingly quick daft zebras jump! The five boxing wizards jump quickly.
Sphinx of black quartz, judge my vow.

Typesetting is the composition of text by means of arranging type. Stored
letters and other symbols are retrieved and ordered according to a language's
orthography for visual display. A hyphenation algorithm decides where an
unusually long word such as antidisestablishmentarianism may be divided at the
end of a line, and Knuth and Plass showed that choosing all of a paragraph's
breaks at once produces noticeably better spacing than choosing them greedily,
one line after another.
